summary: Configured persistent resilient static routing. Direct primary-transit is preferred; automatic failover through VyOS occurred in approximately 3.65 seconds, and direct-path preference returned approximately 0.49 seconds after restoration. Endpoint source addresses were preserved and management remained outside the routed data plane.
actions_performed: Configured node1 lan-a/lan-b interfaces and a default-drop VyOS forwarding policy allowing only endpoint traffic.
Configured persistent endpoint addresses, metric-100 VyOS fallback routes, and metric-10 monitored direct routes.
Enabled route-monitor services on node2 and node3 with two-failure withdrawal and automatic recovery.
Disrupted only node3 primary-transit, verified fallback behavior, restored it, and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: Preferred direct path and persistent fallback configuration
evidence.summary: Both endpoints have metric-10 routes through enp8s0 and metric-100 routes through node1; monitors are enabled and active, while VyOS configuration is saved.

Healthy traffic used the direct path (TTL 64). After node3 enp8s0 was taken down, traffic resumed through VyOS (TTL 63) in about 3.65 seconds. After restoration, TTL returned to 64 in about 0.49 seconds, with both endpoints selecting the direct route.
Direct and fallback captures retained sources 10.10.0.2 and 10.20.0.3; ordinary route lookups also select those endpoint source addresses.

evidence.requirement: Management network excluded from routed data plane
evidence.summary: Fallback packets appeared on VyOS eth1 and eth2 but none on management eth0. VyOS forwarding defaults to drop and permits only the exact endpoint flows; endpoint management routes remain on enp1s0.
